<ParamField body="color" type="string | null" default="gray">
  Theme palette name used to derive the background and icon shades. Invalid names use the default theme color.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Icon" type="IconComponent" required>
  Icon component rendered inside the tinted tile.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="size" type="number">
  Icon and tile dimension in pixels. When omitted, the icon uses the medium theme size.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="stroke" type="number">
  Icon stroke width. Defaults to the medium theme stroke.
</ParamField>
